label: Biomedical/lab specimen-analysis context: tokens inside clinical or laboratory research text about cells, tissue, samples, spectroscopy and diagnosis (the model is setting up a specimen or measurement noun), weakly spread over health text

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top negative activations land on tokens inside lab/biomedical text (spectro-, cells, the sample, diagnosis) and census shows 65% of diseases fire it; but strong band samples are scattered (turtles 'them', recipe 'bowl'), so only a broad biomedical-specimen context is supported. Note the + pole is the tissue/pathology-sample feature and this pole is its reversed, weaker side.
